note: BATT4 exemption/deferred list (PL-33b TASK-draft-BATT4-v2, revised by AUTO-265/266). Boundary: a base TOOL/TOOL_ARMOR item may have a battery well or an integral battery pocket only through explicit `pocket_data` (the DDA form) unless it is listed here. Kinds: native (CDF well, no DDA twin), filter (filter/cartridge well, not a battery tool), integral (DDA class integral / BATT2 integral pocket), parked (legacy well, waiting for the appliance packet), retired (obsoletion id MIG1 deletes), no-pocket (DDA has no battery pocket). Not listed: plutonium pack wells (PLUT1) and weld-tank wells, which are not battery storage. LINKUP1c converted the 20 live hold tools; BATT4 removed the mess_kit, crt_mess_kit and voltmeter stores (DDA heats food for free; DDA's voltmeter has no power).
